  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "indexes",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies TxIndex in src/index/txindex.cpp to stop treating I/O and corruption errors as missing transactions.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "TxIndex currently masks index corruption and read errors by returning nullptr instead of throwing an exception. In indexes, data integrity matters most, and silent fallbacks that hide corruption under false negative answers prevent operators from diagnosing database failures."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries RPC/REST/ZMQ label and alters error reporting in src/rpc/rawtransaction.cpp for getrawtransaction.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes misleading RPC error responses that reported internal I/O errors or pruned blocks as missing transactions. While resolving these false negatives provides clear value for RPC client error handling, the underlying operational failure cases are deferrable relative to breaking interface issues."
    },
